DAqX4O2HjsfzJesbSDg7Jw.zh: 越南胡志明市今年截至第38週(9/20)累計報告34,161例病例,其中第38週(9/14-20)報告1,462例,較近4週平均增加3.2%,且高於去年同期,疫情集中於崑島特區及平慶社等行政區。
DAqX4O2HjsfzJesbSDg7Jw.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, has reported 34,161 cases this year as of week 38 (20 September). In week 38 (14–20 September), 1,462 cases were reported, 3.2% above the average of the previous four weeks and higher than the same period last year. The outbreak is concentrated in administrative areas including Côn Đảo special zone and Bình Khánh commune.

Gzg-DJv5NkZ9ozYHBjINHQ.zh: 越南今年全國截至9/21累計報告逾113,000例病例,較去年同期增加,其中河內市今年迄今報告近5,000例,胡志⺠市近期重症數亦增加,因適逢開學季,於幼兒園與小學之疫情快速擴散。當局規劃疫苗於今年10月上市,以提供進一步保護措施。
Gzg-DJv5NkZ9ozYHBjINHQ.en: Viet Nam reported more than 113,000 cases nationwide cumulatively as of 21 September this year, an increase over the same period last year. Hanoi has reported nearly 5,000 cases so far this year, and severe cases in Ho Chi Minh City have also recently increased. As the school year has started, the outbreak is spreading rapidly in kindergartens and primary schools. Authorities plan to launch a vaccine in October this year to provide further protection.

ScZAGFPo_ySS-pBfp9W2cw.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續升溫,今年截至9/6累計報告3萬1,032例病例,已連續5週單週新增超過1,000例,因高溫多雨及高人口密度提供埃及斑蚊極佳繁殖環境,當局呼籲⺠眾應徹底清除孳生源。
ScZAGFPo_ySS-pBfp9W2cw.en: The dengue epidemic in Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to intensify: as of 6 September this year, 31,032 cases have been reported cumulatively, and weekly new cases have exceeded 1,000 for five consecutive weeks. High temperatures, heavy rainfall and high population density provide an excellent breeding environment for Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, and authorities urge people to thoroughly remove breeding sources.

o4MbJHBAFH6zV9hBFDFgaA.zh: 越南疫情上升,今年截至8月中旬累計報告近10萬例病例,為去年同期的2.5倍,近期每週新增逾3,000例,疫情多集中於南部省份與大城市。腸病毒71型占南部地區陽性檢體的56%,且今年轉為C1基因型為主。因適逢開學季,當局加強宣導、推動環境清消與手部衛生。另當局已於今年3月核准腸病毒71型疫苗,規劃於今年底前替2個月至6歲以下兒童施打疫苗。
o4MbJHBAFH6zV9hBFDFgaA.en: Viet Nam's epidemic is rising: as of mid-August this year, nearly 100,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, 2.5 times the same period last year. Recently more than 3,000 cases have been added each week, with cases concentrated in southern provinces and large cities. Enterovirus 71 accounted for 56% of positive specimens in the southern region, and this year the predominant genotype has shifted to C1. As the school year has started, authorities have strengthened communication, promoted environmental disinfection and hand hygiene. Authorities approved an EV71 vaccine in March this year and plan to vaccinate children aged 2 months to under 6 years by the end of this year.

9I_7qadmkNqAL3qTHaRtOQ.zh: 越南胡志明市今年截至第30週(7/20-26)累計報告2萬3,481例病例,較去年同期增加23.9%,其中第30週報告995例病例,較近4週平均增加20%。 菲律賓三寶顏市(Zamboanga)於8/4宣布爆發疫情,今年截至8月初已報告1,241例病例及12例死亡。該市疫情持續上升,已達流行閾,超過50%感染者為10歲(含)以下兒童,全市有39個(/98)行政區受到影響,當局已加強防治措施。
9I_7qadmkNqAL3qTHaRtOQ.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, has reported 23,481 dengue cases cumulatively up to week 30 (20–26 July) this year, a 23.9% increase over the same period last year. Of these, 995 cases were reported in week 30, 20% above the average of the previous four weeks. On 4 August, Zamboanga City in the Philippines declared an outbreak; as of early August, 1,241 cases and 12 deaths had been reported this year. Cases in the city continue to rise and have reached the epidemic threshold, with more than 50% of infections among children aged 10 years and under. Thirty-nine of the city's 98 administrative districts are affected, and authorities have strengthened prevention and control measures.

kRsRJL2oRRijJXpWlj2d6w.zh: 越南疫情持續,今年5/18-6/18報告約9,900例病例,且自去年12月中旬截至今年6月累計報告約5萬5,000例病例,其中10例死亡,疫情約為去年同期(2萬8,081例)的2倍,且去年同期無死亡案例。
kRsRJL2oRRijJXpWlj2d6w.en: The outbreak in Viet Nam continues. From 18 May to 18 June this year, about 9,900 cases were reported, and from mid-December last year to June this year, about 55,000 cases were reported cumulatively, including 10 deaths. The outbreak is about twice the same-period total of last year (28,081 cases), and there were no deaths in the same period last year.

WXvjaIqJKmbqCj57dmAEXQ.zh: 越南同塔省自6/16-20累積報告303例疑病例,其中有25例檢體檢出沙門氏菌,病患皆食用某連鎖麵包店之越南麵包,當局已要求店家停業。該連鎖麵包店前於2024年及今年年初皆曾爆發食品中毒群聚事件。
WXvjaIqJKmbqCj57dmAEXQ.en: In Đồng Tháp Province, Viet Nam, 303 suspected cases were reported cumulatively from 16 to 20 June, and Salmonella was detected in specimens from 25 of them. All patients had eaten Vietnamese bread from a bakery chain, and authorities have ordered the shops to close. The bakery chain had previously experienced food poisoning clusters in 2024 and earlier this year.

5LCj5sh_yKEDTVx1i_ge2A.zh: 越南疫情上升,今年1-5月累計報告逾50,000例病例,約為去年同期病例數的2.5倍,疫情時間較往年提早,病例發生不再局限於特定地區、季節或年齡層,該國大部分地區皆有報告病例,包含過去較少報告病例的北部地區,目前主要流行型別為DENV-2。 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,今年截至6/5累計報告36,168例病例,病例數較去年同期增加約1萬例,近50%病例分布於西部省,另有20例相關死亡病例,其中包括 3 例兒童死亡病例。當局已啟動預防控制計畫。
5LCj5sh_yKEDTVx1i_ge2A.en: Viet Nam's outbreak is rising. Between January and May this year, more than 50,000 cases were reported cumulatively, about 2.5 times the same period last year. The outbreak started earlier than usual, and cases are no longer confined to specific regions, seasons or age groups. Most parts of the country have reported cases, including the northern region, which previously reported few cases. The main circulating serotype is DENV-2. Sri Lanka's outbreak is rising. As of 5 June this year, 36,168 cases have been reported cumulatively, about 10,000 more than the same period last year. Nearly 50% of cases are in the Western Province, and 20 related deaths have been recorded, including 3 child deaths. Authorities have launched a prevention and control plan.

sHyQYSPlEWl1olIXgfWgvg.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情更新,近1週(5/11-17)報告414例病例,較前4週平均數下降,2026年截至第20週累計報告16,892例病例,高於2025年同期。 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,2026年截至5/18累計報告29,589例病例及15例死亡,病例分布於該國25個行政區。
sHyQYSPlEWl1olIXgfWgvg.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: in the most recent week (11–17 May), 414 cases were reported, lower than the average of the previous four weeks. Cumulatively, 16,892 cases were reported up to week 20 of 2026, higher than in the same period of 2025. Sri Lanka outbreak update: as of 18 May 2026, 29,589 cases and 15 deaths had been reported cumulatively, distributed across 25 administrative districts of the country.

hCJEg7XJmotPlDCwX_TxkQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情上升,今年截至第19週累計報告逾16,000例病例,較去年同期上升70%以上。 斯里蘭卡疫情上升,今年截至5/11累計報告27,754例病例及14例死亡,病例數高於去年同期,以西部省病例數最多。
hCJEg7XJmotPlDCwX_TxkQ.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: the outbreak is rising, with more than 16,000 cases reported cumulatively this year as of week 19, up more than 70% from the same period last year. Sri Lanka: the outbreak is rising, with 27,754 cases and 14 deaths reported cumulatively this year as of 11 May. Case numbers are higher than in the same period last year, and the Western Province has the most cases.

LRV312LCVUhs1ayg4X5jgA.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續攀升,今年截至5/3累計報告1萬5,104例病例,其中5例死亡,4月新增5,243例,較3月病例數增加1.6倍,且較去(2025)年同期增加1倍。 斯里蘭卡南部馬塔拉區(Matara)德亞亞地區(Deniyaya)截至5/12報告近50例疑病例,其中5例經實驗室確診為腸病毒腦膜炎,病患多為14-15歲的學童,當局已發布停課通知並加強監測等防治措施。
LRV312LCVUhs1ayg4X5jgA.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to see rising cases: as of 3 May this year, 15,104 cases had been reported cumulatively, including five deaths. There were 5,243 new cases in April, an increase of 1.6 times over March and of 100% over the same period last year. In Deniyaya, in Matara District of southern Sri Lanka, nearly 50 suspected cases had been reported as of 12 May; five were laboratory-confirmed as enterovirus meningitis. Most patients are schoolchildren aged 14–15. Authorities have issued school suspension notices and strengthened surveillance and other control measures.

n5PwyeKujHhJIQsREQA9bQ.zh: 越南南部狂犬病疫情升溫,胡志明市今年截至4/20止,累計報告3例死亡病例;同塔省亦報告1例死亡,病患為狗肉攤商,未被犬隻抓咬傷,經調查發現可能於處理染病狗肉時,遭血液或分泌物經皮膚傷口感染。當局呼籲職業高風險族群應接受暴露前預防疫苗接種,因全國犬隻疫苗涵蓋率偏低,將持續推動國家狂犬病防治計畫。
n5PwyeKujHhJIQsREQA9bQ.en: Rabies is rising in southern Viet Nam. In Ho Chi Minh City, three deaths had been reported cumulatively this year as of 20 April. Dong Thap Province also reported one death; the patient was a dog-meat vendor who had not been bitten or scratched by a dog. Investigation found that infection may have occurred through skin wounds when the vendor handled infected dog meat and was exposed to blood or secretions. Authorities urge high-risk occupational groups to receive pre-exposure vaccination. Because dog vaccination coverage nationwide is low, the national rabies control programme will continue to be promoted.

MjfM2NJuh8v7prcQFZ-5Ew.zh: 越南疫情嚴峻,今年截至 4/14 累計報告 2.6 萬例病例,其中死亡 8 例,10 歲以下之病患占 99%,疫情顯著高於去年同期,且校園群聚持續發生。當局已要求發病兒童須停止上學,並居家隔離 10 天以上。
MjfM2NJuh8v7prcQFZ-5Ew.en: Viet Nam's outbreak is severe: as of 14 April this year, about 26,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including eight deaths. Children under 10 account for 99% of patients. The outbreak is markedly higher than in the same period last year, and school clusters continue to occur. Authorities have required children who fall ill to stop attending school and to isolate at home for more than 10 days.

psnH83zfnEi2lYTMZZfG9g.zh: 越南疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告 31,927 例病例及 4 例死亡,近期該國多地疫情上升,主要分布於南部地區,由於雨季及濕熱天氣,預期疫情可能持續上升。
psnH83zfnEi2lYTMZZfG9g.en: Viet Nam outbreak update: so far this year, 31,927 cases and four deaths have been reported cumulatively. Recently the outbreak has risen in many areas of the country, mainly in the southern region. Given the rainy season and hot, humid weather, the outbreak is expected to continue rising.

bcwbyK5tor03ylod39W8eQ.zh: 越南今年截至第 14 週報告 24 例確定病例,其中 4 例死亡,46%為15 歲以下兒童,目前為社區散發個案,未有群聚事件,近期病例數呈上升趨勢,已高於去年同期(14 例)。當局呼籲民眾保持良好個人衛生習慣,倘出現高燒、頭痛、噁心、頸部僵硬及出血性皮疹等疑症狀,應儘速就醫治療及檢查。
bcwbyK5tor03ylod39W8eQ.en: Viet Nam reported 24 confirmed cases this year through week 14, of which four died. Children under 15 make up 46%. The cases are currently sporadic community cases with no clusters. Recent case numbers have been rising and are higher than the 14 cases reported in the same period last year. Authorities urge people to maintain good personal hygiene, and to seek prompt medical treatment and testing if they develop suspected symptoms such as high fever, headache, nausea, neck stiffness or haemorrhagic rash.

Sh_IPVY_dldYo9a6V1-vzw.zh: 越南今年迄今已累計逾26,000例病例及8例死亡,尤以南部地區疫情嚴峻,其中胡志明市今年截至第14週(3/30-4/5)累計報告1萬496例,第14週即增加1,347例,較前4週平均增加64%。兒童醫院就醫數於近期大幅增加,多為EV71型且衍生重症,許多兒童在危急狀況、呼吸衰竭及心臟休克時被送醫治療,已發生急性腦損傷,惟沒有明顯紅斑或口腔潰瘍,並在12-24小時內死亡。
Sh_IPVY_dldYo9a6V1-vzw.en: Viet Nam has reported more than 26,000 cases and 8 deaths so far this year, with the situation especially severe in the south. Ho Chi Minh City reported 10,496 cases this year through week 14 (30 March–5 April), and week 14 alone saw 1,347 new cases, a 64% increase over the average of the previous four weeks. Paediatric hospital visits have risen sharply recently, mostly for EV71 infections with severe complications. Many children were brought in for treatment in critical condition, with respiratory failure and cardiac shock, and acute brain injury has occurred. However, no obvious erythema or oral ulcers were present, and the children died within 12–24 hours.

Gzu-NK3ThQ60Xm3NkdhcQw.zh: 越南疫情快速上升,胡志明市今年截至3月底累計報告逾9,100例病例,病例數較去年同期增加2.4倍,多為5歲以下兒童,其中EV71型占56%,並報告多起死亡病例。當局表示近期EV71型為C1變異株,該變異株具高毒性且免疫逃脫特性,可能造成重複感染,且大多數嚴重病例並無明顯紅斑症狀。
Gzu-NK3ThQ60Xm3NkdhcQw.en: Viet Nam's epidemic is rising rapidly. Ho Chi Minh City reported more than 9,100 cases cumulatively this year through the end of March, a 2.4-fold increase over the same period last year. Most cases are children under 5 years of age. EV71 accounts for 56% of cases, and multiple deaths have been reported. Authorities say the recent EV71 strain is the C1 variant, which is highly virulent, has immune escape characteristics, may cause re-infection, and in most severe cases no obvious erythema symptoms are present.

BCf6Bt13G9oVCMk84VS3lg.zh: 越南疫情快速上升,今年截至3月累計報告逾25,000例,較去(2025)年同期增加約5倍。南部各省市(含胡志明市)今年截至第12週累計報告17,078例病例,較去年同期增加,其中8例死亡,EV71型於去年11月起再次檢出,迄今占約56%。因今年正每3年一次的流行週期,當局預估疫情將持續上升。
BCf6Bt13G9oVCMk84VS3lg.en: Viet Nam's epidemic is rising rapidly. Cumulative cases this year through March exceed 25,000, about a five-fold increase over the same period last year. In the southern provinces and cities (including Ho Chi Minh City), 17,078 cases were reported cumulatively this year through week 12, an increase over the same period last year, with 8 deaths. EV71 has been detected again since November last year and currently accounts for about 56% of cases. Because this year coincides with the three-yearly epidemic cycle, authorities expect the epidemic to continue rising.

SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.zh: 義大利北部倫巴第大區報告歐洲首例H9N2流感人類感染病例,病患來自非歐洲國家且於該地感染,感染前健康狀況不佳,住院治療中。另已啟動專家小組,以利與相關國際機構進行協調,並持續監控中。 全球約90%報告H9N2病例報告自中國,另越南、印度、埃及、塞內加爾及迦納也曾報告過病例,該病毒主要透過直接接觸受感染之家禽或受污染環境傳播,人類感染症狀輕微,尚未有人際間傳播案例。
SRWlcsopeMe8pi7ASxrsow.en: Lombardy Region in northern Italy has reported Europe's first human H9N2 influenza infection. The patient came from a non-European country and was infected there; the patient was in poor health before infection and is being treated in hospital. Authorities have also activated an expert group to coordinate with relevant international agencies, and monitoring continues. Around 90% of H9N2 cases reported globally have come from China; Viet Nam, India, Egypt, Senegal and Ghana have also reported cases. The virus is transmitted mainly through direct contact with infected poultry or contaminated environments; human infections have mild symptoms, and no human-to-human transmission has been reported.

XtiY6t1-nUMJs89UvFTuvw.zh: 越南胡志明市今年截至3/8累計報告6,450例病例,高於去年同期,另河內3/6-13新增報告136例病例,較前1週增加30例,並有校園群聚事件,重症多為EV71型病毒引起。 中國今年截至2月累計報告約8.8萬例病例,雖疫情已從2025年10月高峰的37萬例持續下降,仍高於2025年同期(2.3萬例)及2024年同期(3.5萬例)。另2025年第51-52週的報告顯示,病毒型別以克沙奇A16型(占26.3%)、腸病毒A71型(占20.4%)占大宗。
XtiY6t1-nUMJs89UvFTuvw.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, reported 6,450 cases cumulatively this year through 8 March, higher than the same period last year. Hanoi also reported 136 new cases during 6–13 March, an increase of 30 cases over the previous week, and a school cluster has occurred; severe cases were mostly caused by EV71. China reported about 88,000 cases cumulatively this year through February. Although the epidemic has continued to decline from its October 2025 peak of 370,000 cases, it remains higher than the same period in 2025 (23,000 cases) and in 2024 (35,000 cases). In addition, reports for weeks 51–52 of 2025 show that the main virus types were Coxsackievirus A16 (26.3%) and Enterovirus A71 (20.4%).

a0UGgLmEWt9Gbjh21Bdv9Q.zh: 英國肯特郡迄3/23累計報告20例實驗室確診及3例可能病例,死亡2例,目前疫苗接種已超過8,000人,接受抗生素使用已超過12,100人,流行菌株經基因定序後確認為B群 Neisseria meningitidis ST‐485,屬已知「高度侵襲性(hyperinvasive)」克隆群之一。 越南今年於河內、河寧、老街及安江等地爆發疫情,並已發布警報,其中安江省富國特區於3/16報告1例死亡病例,為11歲女學生,疫苗接種史不明,且未曾與確診病例接觸,雖接受治療,惟病情仍迅速惡化後死亡,其1位同學出現症狀並已接受治療,家人及鄰居等密切接觸者均已接受預防性抗生素或接種疫苗,迄未通報其他病例。另該國去(2025)年累計報告95例病例且為B型,其中3例死亡,疫情為2024年 (21例)的4.5倍。
a0UGgLmEWt9Gbjh21Bdv9Q.en: Kent County, United Kingdom, has reported 20 laboratory-confirmed cases and 3 probable cases as of 23 March, with 2 deaths. More than 8,000 people have been vaccinated, and more than 12,100 people have received antibiotics. Genomic sequencing confirmed the epidemic strain as serogroup B Neisseria meningitidis ST-485, one of the known hyperinvasive clonal complexes. Viet Nam has had outbreaks this year in Hanoi, Ha Nam, Lao Cai and An Giang and has issued an alert. In Phu Quoc Special Zone of An Giang Province, one death was reported on 16 March in an 11-year-old female student with unknown vaccination history and no contact with a confirmed case; although she received treatment, her condition deteriorated rapidly and she died. One of her classmates developed symptoms and has been treated. Close contacts, including family members and neighbours, have received preventive antibiotics or vaccination, and no other cases have been reported. Viet Nam reported 95 cases last year, all serogroup B, of which 3 died; this year's outbreak is 4.5 times the 21 cases reported in 2024.

VNO3C3cl02JkxUOswWlsgw.zh: 越南疫情上升,今年1-2月河內國家兒童醫院(National Children's Hospital)已有約3,000例兒童病例,其中約1/3住院治療,住院病例數較去年同期上升,顯示疫情進入高峰期。
VNO3C3cl02JkxUOswWlsgw.en: Viet Nam's epidemic is rising. From January to February this year, the National Children's Hospital in Hanoi has seen about 3,000 paediatric cases, of which about one third were hospitalized. Hospitalizations are higher than in the same period last year, indicating that the epidemic has entered its peak period.

YzgEhyG92969MYquvlsclw.zh: 越南南部頭頓市(Vung Tau)3/9報告108例病例,病患最早於3月初發病,51件病患檢體中有28件(占54%)呈沙門氏菌陽性,迄未出現嚴重病例,疑感染源為某商店販售之越南麵包。 英國今年截至2月底累計報告84例病例,病患年齡中位數為33歲,此波疫情自1月起持續上升,經當局調查疑感染源為某大型連鎖超市的醃製豬肉。
YzgEhyG92969MYquvlsclw.en: In Vung Tau City in southern Viet Nam, 108 cases were reported on 9 March. The earliest patients fell ill in early March. Of 51 patient specimens, 28 (54%) tested positive for Salmonella. No severe cases have occurred so far. The suspected source of infection is Vietnamese bread sold at a shop. The United Kingdom reported 84 cases cumulatively this year through the end of February. The median age of patients is 33 years, and this wave has risen continuously since January. Authorities' investigation suggests that the suspected source of infection is cured pork sold by a large chain supermarket.

06qqVO3sfOSGrQAikAyJzA.zh: 越南今(2026)年截至3/7共計8省報告8例死亡病例,分別為萊州/老街/胡志明/永隆/廣義/嘉萊/林同/大樂省(市),當局表示動物狂犬病疫情持續在多地出現,春節後犬貓咬傷人事件顯著增加,呼籲為達2030 年消除狂犬病目標,需要衛生、獸醫及地方當局密切合作,同時提高民眾對寵物接種疫苗、管理犬貓以及正確處理咬傷之認識。該國2025年報告77例死亡病例。
06qqVO3sfOSGrQAikAyJzA.en: As of 7 March this year, Viet Nam has reported 8 rabies deaths in 8 provinces and cities: Lai Châu, Lào Cai, Ho Chi Minh City, Vĩnh Long, Quảng Ngãi, Gia Lai, Lâm Đồng and Đắk Lắk. Authorities say animal rabies continues to appear in many areas, and dog and cat bite incidents increased markedly after the Lunar New Year. They call for close cooperation among health, veterinary and local authorities to achieve the 2030 rabies elimination goal, and for raising public awareness of vaccinating pets, managing dogs and cats, and correctly managing bite wounds. The country reported 77 rabies deaths in 2025.

smOxUtQm9eXHd8xUzodEIQ.zh: 新加坡疫情呈上升趨勢,今年第2週(1/11-17)平均每日新增18例,為2025年10月以來最高,惟仍低於去年同期或去年最高點;越南疫情趨緩,第3週病例數較前4週平均下降19.8%;韓國第3週(1/11-17)就診率為千分之1.5,較前1週下降,惟仍高於去年同期。
smOxUtQm9eXHd8xUzodEIQ.en: Singapore's situation is rising. In week 2 (11–17 January) this year, an average of 18 new cases were reported per day, the highest since October 2025, though still below the same period last year and last year's peak. Viet Nam's situation has eased; in week 3, case numbers fell 19.8% compared with the average of the previous four weeks. In South Korea, the outpatient visit rate in week 3 (11–17 January) was 1.5 per 1,000, down from the previous week but still higher than the same period last year.

pqGn2HlAFEwuhXTQCAG3SQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情上升,近1週報告1,430例病例,該國於2025年累計報告184,903例病例及43例死亡,病例/死亡數皆高於2024年同期。
pqGn2HlAFEwuhXTQCAG3SQ.en: Dengue is rising in Ho Chi Minh City, with 1,430 cases reported over the past week. In 2025, Viet Nam reported 184,903 cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, both higher than in the same period of 2024.

cV3Urstc5zMXVe-PRetKAQ.zh: 越南河內疫情上升,今年截至12/22累計報告6,015例病例,疫情為去年2倍;韓國疫情下降,第50週(12/7-13)就診陽性率降為4.5‰,惟疫情仍高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第51週累計報告785例,低於去年同期。
cV3Urstc5zMXVe-PRetKAQ.en: Case numbers are rising in Hanoi, Viet Nam: 6,015 cases were reported cumulatively as of 22 December this year, double last year's figure. South Korea's situation has declined: the outpatient visit positivity rate in week 50 (7–13 December) fell to 4.5 per 1,000, but remains above the same period over the past three years. Thailand's situation has declined: 785 cases were reported cumulatively in week 51, lower than the same period last year.

6LF4K4nG7wRKreqEpbBxMA.zh: 中國第49-50週(12/1-14)累計報告5萬6,554例病例,其中重症20 例、無死亡病例,病例數較前2週下降43%,惟仍較去年同期高134%;越南胡志明市疫情略降,第49週新增1,484例病例,較前1週減少17%;韓國疫情上下波動,第49週就診陽性率增為5.9‰,高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第50週累計報告848例,低於去年同期。
6LF4K4nG7wRKreqEpbBxMA.en: China reported 56,554 cases in weeks 49–50 (1–14 December), including 20 severe cases and no deaths. Case numbers fell 43% compared with the previous two weeks but remain 134% higher than the same period last year. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, the outbreak eased slightly, with 1,484 new cases in week 49, a 17% decrease from the previous week. In South Korea, the situation fluctuated; the outpatient visit positivity rate rose to 5.9 per 1,000 in week 49, higher than the same period over the past three years. In Thailand, the situation declined, with 848 cases reported cumulatively in week 50, lower than the same period last year.

Sl8VkzOfz7xQObuGJc98Lw.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,第48週(11/24-30)新增1,484例病例,較前4週平均增加0.9%,今年迄今累計達34,127例,該病每年流行高峰期為9-12月;中國疫情自高點下降,11月報告26萬9,337例病例,其中1例死亡,雖較10月疫情(37萬例)略降,惟仍為去年同期4.5倍;韓國疫情下降,第48週就診陽性率5.2‰,仍高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第49週累計報告820例,低於去年同期。
Sl8VkzOfz7xQObuGJc98Lw.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to rise: 1,484 new cases were reported in week 48 (24–30 November), an increase of 0.9% over the average of the previous four weeks. Cumulatively this year, 34,127 cases have been reported. The disease's annual peak season is September to December. China's situation has declined from its peak: 269,337 cases were reported in November, including 1 death. Although this is slightly lower than October (about 370,000 cases), it is 4.5 times the same period last year. South Korea's situation has declined; the outpatient visit positivity rate in week 48 was 5.2 per 1,000, still higher than the same period over the past three years. Thailand's situation has declined; 820 cases were reported cumulatively in week 49, lower than the same period last year.

ASiQZKyqRu7qnFiQy39Kjw.zh: 越南疫情上升,今年截至12/7已報告78,460例病例,其中1例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加15.6%。其中,胡志明市今年迄今累計已逾32,000例病例,僅第47週即報告1,547例病例。該市病例數較去年同期增加64%,重症病例數自42週起持續增加,迄已65例重症,某醫院於11月之18例重症病患中,10例 (56%) 經檢測為EV71陽性,該市已發布健康警報。該國每年報告約5萬至10萬例病例,EV71於該國曾引起多起嚴重疫情。
ASiQZKyqRu7qnFiQy39Kjw.en: Viet Nam's situation is rising: as of 7 December this year, 78,460 cases had been reported, including 1 death, a 15.6% increase over the same period last year. Ho Chi Minh City has cumulatively exceeded 32,000 cases this year, with 1,547 cases reported in week 47 alone. Cases in the city are 64% higher than the same period last year. Severe cases have continued to rise since week 42, reaching 65 so far. Among 18 severe patients at one hospital in November, 10 (56%) tested positive for EV71. The city has issued a health alert. The country usually reports about 50,000–100,000 cases a year, and EV71 has caused several serious outbreaks in the country.

uXqElHLjA0gYuArFop8WJw.zh: 越南疫情更新,近1週(11/14-20)新增6,472例病例及1例死亡,較前1週病例數減少7.3%,今年迄今累計156,828例病例及32例死亡,高於去年同期病例數及死亡數,該國於2022年疫情較為嚴峻,累計逾370,000例病例。 孟加拉疫情更新,近1日新增705例病例,今年迄今累計90,969例病例及366例死亡,病例數以該國南部巴里薩爾專區20,224例為多。 茅利塔亞自今年5月疫情爆發迄今累計7,179例病例(4,029例確診)及1例死亡(致死率為0.01%),主要檢出型別為DENV-1及DENV-2。今年非洲共11國累計報告逾56,000例病例及125例死亡,其中,病例數以蘇丹共和國約42,000例為多,其次為茅利塔亞。
uXqElHLjA0gYuArFop8WJw.en: Viet Nam update: In the past week (14–20 November), 6,472 new cases and 1 death were reported, a 7.3% decrease in cases from the previous week. Year to date, 156,828 cases and 32 deaths have been reported cumulatively, higher than the same period last year in both cases and deaths. The country had a severe outbreak in 2022, with a cumulative total of more than 370,000 cases. Bangladesh update: 705 new cases were reported in the past day. Year to date, 90,969 cases and 366 deaths have been reported, with the most cases, 20,224, in the Barisal division of southern Bangladesh. Mauritania: Since its outbreak began in May this year, a cumulative 7,179 cases (4,029 confirmed) and 1 death (case fatality rate 0.01%) have been reported, mainly serotypes DENV-1 and DENV-2. In Africa this year, 11 countries have cumulatively reported more than 56,000 cases and 125 deaths. Sudan has the most cases, about 42,000, followed by Mauritania.

cOGuzF_AA0-UqHx_cHGTLQ.zh: 美國今年截至11/12共43州報告1,723例,其中206例住院、3例死亡,並報告45起疫情,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於猶他州-亞利桑那州交界處和南卡羅來納州北部地區;該國2024年累計報告285例病例。 越南東北部富壽省爆發學校群聚事件,共計報告29例疑病例,4件樣本中,有3例經實驗室確診,當局已實施民眾衛教、疫苗接種及消毒等緊急措施;該國今年1-4月全國63個省份累計報告逾81,000例疑病例,因新冠疫情及疫苗短缺,兒童常規疫苗接種率降至20年來最低點,導致2024-25年疫情尤其嚴峻,媒體報導全國病例數已趨緩,惟目前尚無更新數據資訊。
cOGuzF_AA0-UqHx_cHGTLQ.en: United States: As of 12 November this year, 1,723 cases had been reported from 43 states, including 206 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 45 outbreaks have been reported. Of the patients, 92% were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Recent outbreaks are concentrated at the Utah–Arizona border area and in northern South Carolina. The country reported 285 cases cumulatively in 2024. Viet Nam: A school cluster outbreak occurred in Phu Tho province in the north-east, with 29 suspected cases reported in total; of 4 specimens, 3 were confirmed by laboratory testing. Authorities have implemented emergency measures including public health education, vaccination and disinfection. From January to April this year, more than 81,000 suspected cases were reported cumulatively across all 63 provinces nationwide. Because of the COVID-19 pandemic and vaccine shortages, routine childhood vaccination rates fell to their lowest level in 20 years, which made the 2024–25 outbreaks especially severe. Media reports say national case numbers have slowed, but no updated data are currently available.

gv1CKaTwsFIbE_ZwxPLjTg.zh: 越南南部同奈省報告2起男童遭病犬咬傷事件,兩人皆已接種疫苗及注射免疫球蛋白,該省今年迄今共30個社/坊報告狂犬病疫情,共有65例犬隻病例及5例人類感染死亡病例,該國動物及人類感染病例均有上升趨勢,且疫情發生省份有擴大趨勢。
gv1CKaTwsFIbE_ZwxPLjTg.en: In Dong Nai province in southern Viet Nam, two boys were bitten by rabid dogs; both had been vaccinated and received rabies immunoglobulin. So far this year, 30 communes and wards in the province have reported rabies outbreaks, with 65 dog cases and five human deaths. Both animal and human infection cases are rising across the country, and the number of provinces affected appears to be expanding.

uQClVrwwrqp9MIDxcUaKAw.zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,近1日報告432例病例,今年累計30,376例病例及118例死亡,病例主要分布於南部巴里薩爾9,929例;該國去年累計101,000餘例病例及570餘例死亡。 越南疫情明顯上升,8月新增21,640例病例及6例死亡,以南部地區疫情較為嚴峻,尤其是胡志明市,該國今年累計67,055例病例及15例死亡,病例數高於去年同期。
uQClVrwwrqp9MIDxcUaKAw.en: Bangladesh outbreak update: 432 cases were reported in the past day. So far this year, 30,376 cases and 118 deaths have been cumulatively reported, mainly in southern Barisal Division, which accounts for 9,929 cases. Last year the country cumulatively reported over 101,000 cases and over 570 deaths. Viet Nam's outbreak has risen markedly: 21,640 new cases and 6 deaths were reported in August. The southern region is most severely affected, especially Ho Chi Minh City. The country has cumulatively reported 67,055 cases and 15 deaths this year, higher than in the same period last year.

vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.zh: 以色列今年4月截至8/10累計報告410例,當局評估該國感染人數介於950-1,700人間,並報告22例住院,其中包含2名嬰幼兒重症案例,該國已啟動疫苗接種活動。 蒙古今年截至8/7累計報告逾1.3萬例,其中10例死亡,病例多為未接種疫苗之兒童,該國於2015-16年期間爆發疫情,報告140例死亡,多數為嬰幼兒。 韓國今年截至8/9累計報告68例,其中49例境外移入及19例與境外移入病例相關病例,病例數為去年同期1.4倍,感染國家以越南42例為多,餘有南非/烏茲別克/泰國/義大利/蒙古,病例多為19歲以上成年人,過半數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不詳。 日本東京都病例數上升,今年截至8/7累計報告28例,超過去年全年病例數(10例),因連續假期將至,外出返鄉人潮增加,當局加強警戒。
vtqJo95ZdO4pL2soABPqFw.en: Israel: 410 cases have been reported since April this year, as of 10 August. Authorities estimate that the number of infected people in the country is between 950 and 1,700. A total of 22 cases were hospitalized, including two severe cases in infants and young children, and the country has launched a vaccination campaign. Mongolia: as of 7 August this year, more than 13,000 cases had been cumulatively reported, including 10 deaths; cases are mostly in unvaccinated children. Mongolia had an outbreak in 2015–16 that reported 140 deaths, most of them infants and young children. South Korea: as of 9 August this year, 68 cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 49 were imported and 19 were linked to imported cases; case numbers are 1.4 times those of the same period last year. Most infections were acquired in Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from South Africa, Uzbekistan, Thailand, Italy and Mongolia. Most cases are adults aged 19 and over, and more than half were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Tokyo Metropolis, Japan: case numbers are rising; as of 7 August this year, 28 cases had been cumulatively reported, exceeding last year's full-year total of 10 cases. With the holiday period approaching and more people travelling out and returning home, authorities have increased vigilance.

KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告逾360萬例病例及2,000例死亡,以美洲地區報告逾330萬例病例為多,其中病例主要分布於巴西;今年亞洲地區之印累計89,845例病例、馬來西亞35,348例、斯里蘭卡31,544例、越南28,787例、泰國24,372例及孟加拉20,218例;非洲地區累計10國報告9,266例病例及18例死亡。
KpXJS-QiaNyZBxaWghEFMg.en: Globally, more than 3.6 million cases and 2,000 deaths have been cumulatively reported this year, with the Americas region accounting for more than 3.3 million cases, mainly in Brazil. In Asia this year, Indonesia has cumulatively reported 89,845 cases, Malaysia 35,348, Sri Lanka 31,544, Viet Nam 28,787, Thailand 24,372 and Bangladesh 20,218. In Africa, 10 countries have reported 9,266 cases and 18 deaths cumulatively.

C2kcz3ipvSX_tvm-ZdtooQ.zh: 越南胡志明市、檳椥、西寧、隆安及同奈省等地疫情上升,該國今年迄今累計32,189例病例及5例死亡,病例數及死亡數均較去年同期為低(36,276例病例及6例死亡),惟目前氣候有利蚊子生長,評估疫情上升風險非常高;該國每年平均報告約10萬例病例及100例死亡,病例主要分布於南部地區,惟近幾年北部及中部等地之病例數亦逐漸增加,尤其於6-11月期間疫情較為嚴峻。
C2kcz3ipvSX_tvm-ZdtooQ.en: Dengue is rising in Ho Chi Minh City and in Binh Duong, Tay Ninh, Long An and Dong Nai provinces. So far this year, Vietnam has reported 32,189 cases and 5 deaths, lower than the same period last year (36,276 cases and 6 deaths). However, current weather favors mosquito growth, and the risk of a rise is assessed as very high. Vietnam reports an average of about 100,000 cases and 100 deaths per year. Cases are mainly in the south, but case numbers have gradually increased in the north and central regions in recent years, especially during June–November, when outbreaks are more severe.

3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.zh: 加拿大今年截至7/5共10省報告3,822例,其中以安大略省及亞伯達省為多,亞伯達省病例數上升,截至7/14報告逾1,200例,當地疫情嚴峻,該省已針對南部及北部部分地區發布警報,由於夏季大型集會增加及學校即將開學,預期疫情風險將持續。 美國今年迄今共39州報告1,288例,已報告27起疫情,病例數已超過2019年全年病例數,為該國宣布消除麻疹以來最高紀錄,該國有近1/3病例為20歲以上成人,92%個案未接種疫苗或接種史不明,自德州於今年1月發生大規模疫情後,已有多個州爆發小規模疫情,同時有大量境外移入個案。 韓國今年截至7/5累計報告65例,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關個案,感染地以越南(42例)為多,餘有烏茲別克、義大利、泰國及蒙古等國,病患多為19歲以上成年人。 英國利物浦報告1例兒童死亡案例,為英蘭地區近5年來第2例死亡,前1例為2023年大曼徹斯特10歲女童,英蘭地區今年迄今報告529例,以倫敦都會區為多,該地區去年報告2,900餘例,為2012年以來新高。
3nkSQVZOk4BA2gLUpTyCXw.en: Canada has reported 3,822 cases in 10 provinces as of 5 July this year, mainly in Ontario and Alberta. Alberta's case count has risen, with more than 1,200 cases reported as of 14 July. The epidemic there is severe, and the province has issued alerts for parts of the south and north. Because of increased large summer gatherings and the imminent start of school, the risk is expected to continue. The United States has reported 1,288 cases in 39 states so far this year, with 27 outbreaks reported. The number of cases has already exceeded the total for all of 2019, the highest since the country declared measles eliminated. Nearly one third of cases are adults aged over 20, and 92% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Since a large outbreak in Texas in January this year, several states have experienced small outbreaks, alongside many imported cases. South Korea reported 65 cases as of 5 July this year, all imported or linked to imported cases. Most were from Viet Nam (42 cases), with others from Uzbekistan, Italy, Thailand and Mongolia, and most patients were adults aged 19 and over. In Liverpool, United Kingdom, one child died; this is the second death in England in five years, the previous being a 10-year-old girl in Greater Manchester in 2023. England has reported 529 cases so far this year, mainly in Greater London. England reported more than 2,900 cases last year, the highest since 2012.

lEhiroOiiIpi17CrLjFvWw.zh: 亞洲國家第24-26週(6/8-28)疫情更新,中國疫情上升,新增約8.8萬例病例,今年迄今累計253,093例,117例重症,無死亡案例;疫情低於近2年同期;香港疫情上升,就診陽性率為0.7‰,為今年最高點;日本疫情上升,定醫平均病例數0.33,為今年最高,惟低於近3年同期;越南今年截至4月累計報告逾1.5萬例病例,其中,胡志明市病例數較去年同期增加49%;泰國今年截至6月累計報告約2.4萬例病例,迄無死亡個案,病患年齡以0-4歲(70%)及10-14歲為多(22%)。
lEhiroOiiIpi17CrLjFvWw.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 24–26 (8–28 June): China's epidemic is rising, with about 88,000 new cases in the period. Cumulatively this year, 253,093 cases and 117 severe cases have been reported, with no deaths. The epidemic is lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Hong Kong's epidemic is rising, with a clinic positivity rate of 0.7‰, the highest point this year. Japan's epidemic is rising, with an average of 0.33 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. PdV3ncAULmpiulSuqPYNkA.en: Dengue is rising in the Philippines. From 11 to 24 May, 6,720 cases were reported, more than the 6,192 in the previous two weeks. v63fMwnP7j6aezHzajzRGQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第22週(5/26-6/1)全球陽性率3.5%,除非洲、西太平洋及東地中海區以外,餘區域陽性率皆上升。 馬來西亞疫情上升,5月下旬每日新增300例病例,較去年12月高峰為高,住院數亦上升,陽性率達68%;韓國疫情經4月高峰後,呈波動下降趨勢,第24週(6/8-14)新增93例病例,為第10週以來最低,陽性率為9.9%,以NB.1.8.1為主;日本第24週(6/9-15)定點平均報告數0.90例,較前一週0.92例下降,自年初以來,疫情持續下降;越南胡志明市疫情經4-5月高峰後,呈下降趨勢,第24週(6/9-15)報告32例,較前2週下降66%;香港第24週(6/8-14)陽性率4.89%,陽性率及定醫就診率持續呈下降趨勢,污水監測數據顯示,以NB.1.8.1為主要流行變異株。 美國疫情下降,自1月初每週1,000例死亡,下降至5月每週200例,第20週(5/11-17)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比最高,預測NB.1.8.1將成為主流變異株;加拿大疫情處低點,病例數自1月之每週近4,000例,下降至5月每週約500例,第22週(5/25-31)陽性率2.8%,以變異株LP.8.1及NB.1.8.1占比為高。  歐洲11國處疫情高點,第23週(6/1-7)門診陽性率10.2%,較前週高峰(10.9%)稍低,惟住院陽性率達5.9%,為今年新高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢;以NB.1.8.1變異株占比最高,LP.8.1占比次高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
v63fMwnP7j6aezHzajzRGQ.en: Epidemic update: In week 22 of 2025 (26 May–1 June), global positivity was 3.5%, with increases in all regions except Africa, the Western Pacific and the Eastern Mediterranean. Malaysia: the epidemic is rising. Daily new cases were about 300 in late May, higher than the December peak; hospitalizations are also rising, and positivity reached 68%. South Korea: after a peak in April, the epidemic has fluctuated and declined. In week 24 (8–14 June), 93 new cases were reported, the lowest since week 10, with positivity of 9.9%, mainly NB.1.8.1. Japan: in week 24 (9–15 June) the sentinel average was 0.90, down from 0.92 the previous week, and the epidemic has continued to decline since the beginning of the year. Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam: after a peak in April–May, the epidemic is declining; 32 cases were reported in week 24 (9–15 June), down 66% over the previous two weeks. Hong Kong: in week 24 (8–14 June), positivity was 4.89%. Positivity and sentinel clinic consultation rates continue to decline, and wastewater data show NB.1.8.1 as the main circulating variant. United States: the epidemic is declining. Deaths fell from about 1,000 per week in early January to about 200 per week in May. Positivity in week 20 (11–17 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest shares; NB.1.8.1 is predicted to become the dominant variant. Canada: the epidemic is at a low point. Weekly cases fell from nearly 4,000 in January to about 500 in May. Positivity in week 22 (25–31 May) was 2.8%, with LP.8.1 and NB.1.8.1 accounting for high shares. Europe: 11 countries are at the epidemic peak. Outpatient positivity in week 23 (1–7 June) was 10.2%, slightly lower than the previous peak of 10.9%, but hospital positivity reached 5.9%, the highest this year. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently been trending upward, with NB.1.8.1 accounting for the highest share and LP.8.1 the second highest. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

RzxjqEviDVDOzw1G0PXMNQ.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 22–24 (25 May–14 June): China's epidemic is rising, with more than 52,000 new cases in May. Japan's epidemic is rising slowly, with an average of 0.19 cases per sentinel clinic. Japan has reported 5 Echo 11 virus cases so far this year, as of 19 June. In Hanoi, Viet Nam, 112 new cases were reported in one week, and the city has cumulatively reported 2,839 cases so far this year as of 13 June, an increase over the same period last year. Singapore's epidemic has declined from its peak, with an average of 33 new cases per day, still higher than the same period last year. South Korea's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 2‰. Hong Kong's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 0.3‰.

_TPHZe2fI7BCXxFY8opjvw.zh: 越南今年截至4月上旬累計20例死亡,較2024年同期死亡數為高。當局表示4至8月間天氣炎熱,感染數及死亡數增加,尤以中/北部地區省份為多,呼籲民眾倘被犬貓咬傷,應立即就診,並定期為犬貓完整接種疫苗。
_TPHZe2fI7BCXxFY8opjvw.en: As of early April this year, Vietnam has reported 20 deaths cumulatively, higher than the number of deaths in the same period of 2024. 1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.zh: 韓國今年迄今累計52例,病例數為去年同期的1.3倍,所有病例皆為境外移入及其相關病例,感染國家以越南33例為多,另有烏茲別克/泰國/義大利各1例,超過60%的病例未接種疫苗或接種狀況不明,當局表示因新冠疫情後國際交流頻繁,且全球疫情持續,尤其是東南亞地區,由於持續有前往流行地區之病例輸入並造成傳播,需對境外移入風險保持警戒。 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/1報告12起疫情,累計30州935例,其中121例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,北達科他州近期報告自2011年來首例;加拿大今年截至4/19共7省1,177例,以安大略省(993)為多,另亞伯達省病例數迅速上升,截至5/6累計報告287例,為該省1987年以來最高;墨西哥北部契瓦瓦州(Chihuahua)病例數遽增,今年迄今報告786例,並報告1例成年男性死亡案例,該國去年同期僅報告7例。 法國今年截至4/13累計報告427例,接近去(2024)年全年病例數(483),其中,全國近60%的省份報告病例,以1-4歲兒童為多,另報告58例併發症,9例於ICU治療,並報告1例成年死亡病例。
1L6DELI519vYpkQfXviY6A.en: South Korea has reported 52 cases so far this year, 1.3 times the same period last year. All cases were imported or linked to imported cases; the countries of infection were mainly Viet Nam with 33 cases, plus 1 each in Uzbekistan, Thailand and Italy. More than 60% of cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Authorities said that international exchange has been frequent since the COVID-19 pandemic and the global outbreak continues, especially in Southeast Asia; because cases continue to be imported from areas with outbreaks and cause transmission, vigilance against the risk of imported cases must be maintained. North America update: as of 1 May this year, the United States has reported 12 outbreaks, with 935 cases cumulatively across 30 states, including 121 hospitalizations and 3 deaths; Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. North Dakota recently reported its first case since 2011. As of 19 April, Canada had 1,177 cases across 7 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (993); case numbers in Alberta have risen rapidly, with 287 cases reported cumulatively as of 6 May, the highest for the province since 1987. In Chihuahua State in northern Mexico, case numbers have surged, with 786 cases reported this year so far, including 1 adult male death; the country reported only 7 cases in the same period last year. France reported 427 cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April, close to last year's full-year total of 483. Nearly 60% of the country's provinces have reported cases, mainly among children aged 1–4. A total of 58 complications were reported, 9 of which were treated in the ICU, and 1 adult death was reported.

Ybv1xcysxNmFXpDRj6wrIw.en: Victoria State in Australia has experienced its most severe outbreak in nearly 10 years, with 23 cases cumulatively this year, exceeding last year's full-year total. Locally acquired cases have increased, and most cases were not fully vaccinated. Authorities say the risk of transmission has risen in Greater Melbourne and nearby areas, and the imported risk from returning travelers must continue to be addressed. Viet Nam update: in the most recent week (19–25 April), more than 3,900 new cases were reported, a 4.3% decrease from the previous week. The outbreak has eased in most areas recently, but it continues in the northern region, and 81,000 cases have been reported cumulatively this year as of late April. Currently 52 provinces have reached the target of 95% vaccination coverage, but coverage remains low in remote and urban areas, and some people are hesitant about vaccines and there is a shortage of primary healthcare workers, so outbreak control still faces challenges. The ECDC published its 2024 measles epidemiological report: more than 35,000 cases were reported last year, nearly 10 times the more than 3,900 cases in 2023. The European region's outbreak began rising in 2023; the 2024 notification rate was 77.4 cases per million population, higher than 9.1 in 2023 and also higher than the pre-pandemic level (27.2). Romania had the highest rate, accounting for 87% of EU cases. Most cases were in infants under 1 year, but in some countries adults accounted for 28–53% of cases. Of last year's 23 deaths, 22 were in Romania, and more than half were children under 5. First-dose vaccination coverage in EU member states last year was 93.9%, lower than 94.2% in 2023; only 4 countries reached the 95% second-dose target, and most member states did not reach recommended vaccination levels.

aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.zh: 本週摘要:  人類疫情:本週無新增人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS): 共10國於2025/1/7-4/23期間新增41起H5N1疫情,匈牙利13起、波蘭9起、越南7起、美國5起、瑞典2起、南韓/比利時/法國/芬蘭/立陶宛各1起。 日本於2025/4/11-4/24期間新增3起H3N8疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  乳牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,031 (10)起疫情,近期主要集中於愛達荷州、加州及亞利桑那州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,300例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第16週計410個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中,3州(加州、明蘇達、紐澤西)4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:外媒報導2024年H1N2豬流感研究,病毒於歐洲由禽類跨物種傳播至豬隻形成H1N2 1C譜系,自2011-24年間報告至少29例人類感染事件,其中近半數發生於2021年後。據調查顯示多數人對該病毒無免疫力,目前疫苗對該病毒保護效力較低;於動物實驗中,病毒可與人類呼吸道受體結合,且可在支氣管細胞中有效複製,具高度穩定性及高活性神經胺酸酶等特性,評估具有人際傳播潛力。惟現有證據顯示病毒致死率低,於豬隻感染症狀亦屬輕微,且未具高致病性,惟因具備人際傳播潛力及多數人無免疫能力,仍需持續納入監測及定期風險評估。 年度摘要:  人類病例: H5N1流感10例 (2003年迄今累計973*例)、H9N2流感3例(迄今累計131例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。(依WHO統計方式將美國H5流感病例列為H5N1流感病例) 禽類/動物案例:累計51國家/地區通報1,601起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議:FAO/WHO/WOAH於4/17針對H5流感病毒發表風險評估,目前H5 2.3.4.4b病毒仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物,且未發生人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生及飼養動物中,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,於一般大眾仍低,於常接觸受汙染動物或環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸的方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲各國加強對易感染動物及高危險人群之監測。
aXp7XeXQ9zLYEdt7JkYEJA.en: Summary for this week: Human cases: no new human infections were reported this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 10 countries reported 41 new H5N1 outbreaks between 7 January and 23 April 2025: Hungary 13, Poland 9, Viet Nam 7, the United States 5, Sweden 2, and one each in South Korea, Belgium, France, Finland and Lithuania. Japan reported 3 new H3N8 outbreaks between 11 and 24 April 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: Herds: since March last year, 1,031 (10) outbreaks have been reported cumulatively across 17 states, with recent cases concentrated in Idaho, California and Arizona. Human infection via cattle: at least 9,300 cases have been monitored cumulatively, 218 tested, of which 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 16, 410 sampling sites provided test reports, and 4 sampling sites in 3 states (California, Minnesota and New Jersey) detected H5-positive results. Other updates: foreign media reported on a 2024 study of H1N2 swine influenza. The virus was transmitted from birds to pigs in Europe, forming the H1N2 1C lineage; at least 29 human infection events were reported between 2011 and 2024, nearly half of them after 2021. Investigations show that most people have no immunity to this virus, and current vaccines offer less protection against it. In animal experiments, the virus could bind to human respiratory receptors and replicate efficiently in bronchial cells, and it showed high stability and highly active neuraminidase; it is assessed to have potential for human-to-human transmission. However, current evidence shows that the virus has a low fatality rate, causes mild symptoms in pigs, and is not highly pathogenic. Nevertheless, given its potential for human-to-human transmission and the fact that most people lack immunity, it should remain under continued surveillance and regular risk assessment. Annual summary: Human cases: 10 H5N1 influenza cases (973* cumulative since 2003) and 3 H9N2 influenza cases (131 cumulative); most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. (Following WHO counting methods, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 influenza cases.) Avian and animal cases: 1,601 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have been reported cumulatively by 51 countries and regions. Assessment and recommendations: FAO, WHO and WOAH published a risk assessment on H5 influenza viruses on 17 April. Currently, H5 2.3.4.4b viruses are still avian viruses; most human cases had direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals, and no human-to-human transmission has occurred. Because the virus is widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and the global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the risk is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main factors are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Countries are urged to strengthen surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups.

OZWF_6Awucwbnw2NZkfr7Q.en: Viet Nam update: in the most recent week (12–17 April), more than 4,100 suspected cases were reported, down 8.8% from more than 4,500 the previous week, with 2 deaths. So far this year, 76,000 cases have been reported cumulatively across 63 provinces and cities, of which more than 8,600 were confirmed and 10 died. Authorities say case numbers have declined recently; new cases are mostly in the north, and other areas have eased. After large-scale vaccination, cases among children under 10 have slowed, but cases among those over 10 are still rising. Currently 52 provinces and cities have reached the target of more than 95% vaccination coverage, but coverage remains low in remote and urban areas, and some people are hesitant about vaccines and there is a shortage of primary healthcare workers, so outbreak control still faces challenges. Kyrgyzstan's outbreak is severe: as of 10 April this year, more than 5,100 cases had been reported, and case numbers have risen rapidly. Authorities say some people have not been vaccinated for religious reasons or due to vaccine hesitancy; unvaccinated people are now legally restricted from entering educational institutions, and the public is urged to get vaccinated. The United States reported 800 cases and 3 deaths in 25 states as of 17 April this year, with 10 outbreaks reported; more than 600 cases were in Texas, and 3 other states (Louisiana, Missouri and Virginia) reported their first cases this year. As of 5 April, Canada had reported 880 cases across 6 provinces this year, 804 of them in Ontario; most cases are linked to the outbreak that broke out in New Brunswick last October, and the country's case count has reached its highest level since 1998.

mbqyo_nGNRdMAcj542Syxg.zh: 越南3/21公布今年迄今共63省市報告4.2萬餘例疑病例,其中逾4,000例確診及5例死亡,以南部(54%)為多,次為中部(20%),多數病例為9個月至15歲以下孩童,占比超過70%,其中超過95%未接種疫苗。目前病例集中於都會地區,惟山區省分病例數呈增加趨勢,目前預期疫情將下降,惟全國各地仍將持續發生病例,尤其是山區及疫苗覆蓋率低之省分。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/25累計報告379例(德州327例/新墨西哥州43例/奧克拉荷馬州9例),其中42例住院,2例死亡,該國公布今年截至3/20已有18州報告378例,其中64例住院。 PAHO於3/24發布美洲地區風險評估,截至3/15共4國報告507例,分別為美國301例(含2例死亡)、加拿大173例、墨西哥22例及阿根廷11例,病例數較去年同期91例上升5.5倍。因病毒於該區持續流行,多數國家疫苗覆蓋率未達95%目標,且新冠疫情期間疫苗接種中斷,疫苗猶豫情形增加及弱勢族群醫療可近性有限等因素,評估整體風險為高,評估信心水準為高。 吉爾吉斯今年迄今報告4,055例,其中,8例兒童死亡,首都比斯凱克、北部楚河州與南部奧什州病例數大幅上升,超過95%病例未接種疫苗;該國去年報告1.4萬餘例及6例死亡,疫情上升主要為疫苗覆蓋率低所致,比斯凱克覆蓋率僅63%。
mbqyo_nGNRdMAcj542Syxg.en: Viet Nam announced on 21 March that 63 provinces and cities have reported over 42,000 suspected cases so far this year, of which over 4,000 are confirmed, with 5 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the south (54%), followed by the central region (20%). Most cases are children aged from 9 months to under 15 years, accounting for over 70%, and over 95% were unvaccinated. Cases are currently concentrated in urban areas, but numbers are rising in mountainous provinces. Although the outbreak is expected to decline, cases will continue to occur across the country, especially in mountainous areas and provinces with low vaccination coverage. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 25 March, 379 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 327, New Mexico 43, Oklahoma 9), of which 42 were hospitalized and 2 died. The United States reported that as of 20 March, 378 cases had been reported from 18 states, of which 64 were hospitalized. PAHO issued a risk assessment for the Americas on 24 March. As of 15 March, 4 countries had reported 507 cases: the United States 301 (including 2 deaths), Canada 173, Mexico 22 and Argentina 11. This is 5.5 times the 91 cases reported in the same period last year. Because the virus continues to circulate in the region, most countries have not reached the 95% vaccination coverage target, vaccination was disrupted during the COVID-19 pandemic, vaccine hesitancy has increased and access to healthcare for vulnerable groups is limited, the overall risk is assessed as high, with high confidence. Kyrgyzstan has reported 4,055 cases so far this year, including 8 child deaths. Case numbers have risen sharply in the capital Bishkek, northern Chuy Region and southern Osh Region, and over 95% of cases were unvaccinated. Kyrgyzstan reported over 14,000 cases and 6 deaths last year. The increase is mainly due to low vaccination coverage; coverage in Bishkek is only 63%.

4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.zh: 多國疫情持續:  韓國自去年12月迄今報告18例,其中13例為境外移入,病例皆來自越南;香港報告今年首例,為越南境外移入個案;日本第10週(3/6-12)新增12例,新增病例數為今年以來新高,累計報告22例,其中15例為境外移入,感染國家以越南(10例)為多,近期發現數例未有境外旅遊史個案,該國將於4月舉行大型博覽會,海外遊客眾多,呼籲加強相關防疫措施。 美國中南部疫情持續,截至3/18累計報告317例(德州279例/新墨西哥州38例),其中38例住院,2例死亡,另鄰近奧克拉荷馬州報告4例與此次疫情相關病例,該國今年截至3/13共15州報告301例,並於3/7發布麻疹疫情健康警示。 澳洲今年迄今報告29例,病例多來自維多利亞州及新南威爾斯州,兩州各報告13例,病例多為境外移入,感染國包含越南、印等國,該國2023-24年分別報告26及57例。
4eARB-eyLalV2EeoFCzUOw.en: Measles continues in several countries. South Korea has reported 18 cases since last December, 13 of them imported, all from Viet Nam. Hong Kong reported its first case this year, an imported case from Viet Nam. Japan added 12 cases in week 10 (6–12 March), the highest weekly number this year, bringing the cumulative total to 22, of which 15 were imported. Viet Nam is the most common source country, with 10 cases. Several recent cases had no overseas travel history. Japan will host a large expo in April with many overseas visitors, and authorities call for strengthened preventive measures. The US south-central outbreak continues: as of 18 March, 317 cases had been reported cumulatively (Texas 279, New Mexico 38), of which 38 were hospitalized and 2 died. Neighbouring Oklahoma reported 4 cases related to this outbreak. As of 13 March, 15 states had reported 301 cases this year, and on 7 March the US issued a health alert on measles. Australia has reported 29 cases so far this year, mostly from Victoria and New South Wales, with 13 cases in each. Most cases are imported, from countries including Viet Nam and India. Australia reported 26 cases in 2023 and 57 in 2024.

6ESzxNGHW6IvMrf9ltVKKg.zh: 東南亞疫情嚴峻:  菲律賓:該國今年截至3/1報告922例,較去年同期683例上升35%,其中近70%未接種疫苗。 越南:今年迄今報告近4萬例疑病例,其中超過3,400例確診及5例死亡,病例分布以南部地區為多,多數病例為15歲以下兒童,該國疫苗接種率仍低,部分省分接種率僅40%。
6ESzxNGHW6IvMrf9ltVKKg.en: Measles is severe in Southeast Asia. Philippines: this year, as of 1 March, 922 cases have been reported, up 35% from 683 in the same period last year; nearly 70% were unvaccinated. Viet Nam: nearly 40,000 suspected cases have been reported so far this year, of which over 3,400 are confirmed, with 5 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the south, and most are children under 15. Viet Nam's vaccination rate remains low, and in some provinces coverage is only 40%.

7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.zh: 全球疫情嚴峻:  非洲:今年迄今累計7國報告2.1萬餘例疑病例,其中確診3,600餘例及54例死亡,病例集中於摩洛哥,今年迄今報告超過2萬例及37例死亡。 歐洲:ECDC更新2025年1月麻疹資訊,17國報告1,033例,其中以羅馬亞663例為多,其次為義大利74例及西班牙70例,餘14國報告病例數為1-67例。歐盟多國仍持續發生疫情,去年病例數遽增,全年報告3.2萬餘例,其中19例死亡,ECDC表示依據疾病季節模式,評估今年春季病例數將持續增加。因歐洲多數國家皆未達到完整接種之水準,呼籲各國應積極接種。荷蘭今年迄2月累計報告63例,多數病例為境外移入及其接觸者,境外移入病例多來自摩洛哥及羅馬亞。 亞洲:越南河內市近1週(2/28-3/7)新增120例,今年迄今累計報告745例,去年同期則無報告病例;日本第9週(2/27-3/5)新增4例,為今年以來新高,該國累計報告9例,多為境外移入,近期千葉縣及埼玉縣各報告1例自越南移入個案。 美洲:美國德州及新墨西哥州疫情持續,今年截至3/11累計報告256例(德州223例),其中30例住院,2例死亡;加州洛杉磯郡報告今年首例,病患具臺灣旅遊史,於3/5返國,目前相關單位調查中。美洲地區今年截至2/21,共4國報告268例,顯著高於去年同期之60例。
7SB9FK0sqIkDoUqxTsbclg.en: Global outbreaks remain severe. Africa: so far this year, 7 countries have reported over 21,000 suspected cases, including over 3,600 confirmed and 54 deaths. Cases are concentrated in Morocco, which has reported over 20,000 cases and 37 deaths this year. Europe: ECDC has updated its measles data for January 2025. 17 countries reported 1,033 cases, of which Romania had 663, followed by Italy with 74 and Spain with 70; the remaining 14 countries reported 1–67 cases each. Several EU countries continue to have outbreaks. Cases surged last year, with over 32,000 reported for the full year, 19 of them fatal. ECDC says that based on seasonal patterns, case numbers are expected to keep rising this spring. Because most European countries have not reached full vaccination levels, it calls on countries to vaccinate actively. The Netherlands reported 63 cases so far this year up to February; most were imported cases and their contacts, mainly from Morocco and Romania. Asia: Hanoi, Viet Nam, added 120 cases in the past week (28 February–7 March), with 745 cases reported so far this year and none in the same period last year. Japan added 4 cases in week 9 (27 February–5 March), the highest this year; it has reported 9 cases cumulatively, mostly imported, and recently one imported case each from Viet Nam was reported in Chiba and Saitama prefectures. Americas: outbreaks continue in Texas and New Mexico, USA; as of 11 March, 256 cases had been reported this year (223 in Texas), of which 30 were hospitalized and 2 died. Los Angeles County reported its first case this year, in a patient with a travel history to Taiwan who returned on 5 March; investigation is ongoing. As of 21 February, 4 countries in the Americas had reported 268 cases this year, well above the 60 in the same period last year.

Tx0L-kcZBZ2PewUA_suUbw.zh: 越南河內市今年迄今累計報告625例,去年同期則無報告病例,該市疫情自年初迅速蔓延,多數病患未接種疫苗或未完整接種疫苗,其中1歲以下幼兒病例持續增加,評估疫情將持續,尤其該地區近期連續降雨,增加傳播風險,當局已進行疫苗接種工作。 日本橫濱市於2/26-27新增2例,為20多歲女性及40多歲男性,2人分別自泰國及越南返國,個案無流行病學關聯;該國今年截至2/26累計報告6例,其中1例本土病例,5例為境外移入,多來自越南。 美國德州疫情更新,截至3/4,累計報告159例,其中22例住院,1例死亡;鄰近新墨西哥州利郡累計報告9例。該國今年截至2/27報告3起疫情,共9州報告164例,其中32例住院,多數病例未接種疫苗。
Tx0L-kcZBZ2PewUA_suUbw.en: Hanoi, Viet Nam, has reported 625 cumulative cases so far this year, with no cases reported in the same period last year. The outbreak in the city has spread rapidly since the start of the year. Most patients were unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated, and cases among children under one year old continue to rise. Authorities expect the outbreak to continue, especially as recent continuous rain in the area increases transmission risk. Vaccination work is under way. In Yokohama City, Japan, 2 cases were added on 26–27 February: a woman in her 20s and a man in his 40s, who had returned from Thailand and Viet Nam respectively, with no epidemiological link between them. Japan has reported 6 cases this year as of 26 February, 1 of them locally acquired and 5 imported, mostly from Viet Nam. In Texas, USA, as of 4 March, 159 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 22 were hospitalized and 1 died. Lea County in neighbouring New Mexico has reported 9 cases cumulatively. The United States reported 3 outbreaks this year as of 27 February, with 164 cases in 9 states, of which 32 were hospitalized; most cases were unvaccinated.

0KhKPqFgPuM2KNk1BQAeng.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情上升,該市今年迄今累計報告3,400餘例病例,病例數遽增且高於去年同期,預期疫情可能會提早開始。當局已採取預防措施,以控制疫情。 斯里蘭卡疫情更新,今年2/1-4已報告419例病例,今年截至2/3累計報告5,300餘例病例及2例死亡,病例數以西部省2,300餘例最多。 孟加拉疫情更新,最近1天內新增6例病例,今年迄今累計1,500餘例病例及13例死亡,去年累計101,200餘例病例及575例死亡。
0KhKPqFgPuM2KNk1BQAeng.en: Dengue is rising in Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam. The city has reported over 3,400 cases so far this year; case numbers have risen sharply and are higher than the same period last year, and the outbreak may start earlier than expected. Authorities have taken preventive measures to control it. Sri Lanka update: 419 cases were reported between 1 and 4 February this year; as of 3 February, over 5,300 cases and 2 deaths have been reported cumulatively this year, with the Western Province accounting for the most, at over 2,300. Bangladesh update: 6 new cases were reported in the last day; so far this year, over 1,500 cases and 13 deaths have been reported, and last year over 101,200 cases and 575 deaths were recorded.

G3v8_rRHemtXNeSMgyoeFA.zh: 美國德州西部蓋恩斯郡(Gaines County)爆發疫情,累計報告24例,其中9例住院,多數病例為學齡兒童,此波疫情可能與當地學校群聚相關,目前仍調查中。另該郡因某些因素,兒童接種率較低,且當地有許多自學學童,實際未接種數可能更高,當局已推動疫苗接種活動。 越南於去年報告45,550例疑病例,其中超過7,500例確診及16例死亡,約25%確診病例為9個月以下嬰幼兒,WHO已將該國疫情風險評估為非常高,該國已展開全國疫苗接種活動。 韓國濟州島報告5年來首例病例,病患於1/22入境該國前具越南旅遊史,目前相關接觸者無症狀,該國今年累計報告3例,皆為境外移入。
G3v8_rRHemtXNeSMgyoeFA.en: Gaines County in West Texas, USA, has an outbreak with 24 cumulative cases, of which 9 were hospitalized. Most patients are school-age children. The outbreak may be linked to school clusters locally, and the investigation is ongoing. Child vaccination coverage in the county is low for several reasons, and there are many homeschooled children, so the actual number of unvaccinated children may be higher. Authorities have promoted vaccination campaigns. Viet Nam reported 45,550 suspected cases last year, of which over 7,500 were confirmed and 16 died. About 25% of confirmed cases were infants under 9 months old. WHO has assessed the outbreak risk in Viet Nam as very high, and the country has launched a nationwide vaccination campaign. South Korea's Jeju Island reported its first case in five years. The patient had a travel history to Viet Nam before entering South Korea on 22 January. Contacts are currently asymptomatic. South Korea has reported 3 cases this year, all imported.

rucJFgx6QuVnEHbLjA6-Kg.zh: 越南於春節期間(1/25-2/2)報告逾1,500例,該國於春節前重症數及併發症患者數上升,近期兒童病例數及重症數亦增加,因春節聚會增加及人潮聚集,評估春節後疫情將持續上升。
rucJFgx6QuVnEHbLjA6-Kg.en: Viet Nam reported more than 1,500 cases during the Lunar New Year period (25 January–2 February). Severe cases and complications rose before the holiday, and recent numbers of child cases and severe cases have also increased. Because of more gatherings and crowds during the Lunar New Year, the outbreak is expected to keep rising after the holiday.

VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.zh: 多國疫情上升,病例數高於歷年同期:  亞洲:中國去(2024)年報告49萬餘例,為2023年14倍,近期疫情已趨緩,病例數已降至單月1萬例以下;韓國去年報告逾4.7萬例,今(2025)年迄今報告已逾1,600例,遠高於往年單年不超過千例水平;日本病例數持續上升,近期處高點,惟疫情仍低於新冠疫情前規模;越南去年報告1,000餘例,為2023年21.9倍。 大洋洲:澳洲於去年報告逾5.7萬例病例,為2023年23.3倍,今年初疫情持續,迄今累計報告逾3,000例;紐西蘭自去年10月中旬迄今累計報告1,200餘例,其中101例住院,1例死亡。 美洲:美國去年累計報告3.5萬餘例,為2023年同期的6倍,近期病例數呈上升趨勢;巴西去年報告逾6,000例,為2014年以來新高。
VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.en: Several countries have seen rising case numbers, above same-period levels in previous years. Asia: China reported over 490,000 cases last year (2024), 14 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak has recently eased, and monthly cases have fallen below 10,000. South Korea reported over 47,000 cases last year, and so far this year (2025) more than 1,600 cases, far above the level of previous years, when no single year exceeded 1,000 cases. Japan's case numbers continue to rise and are currently near a peak, although the outbreak remains below the scale seen before the COVID-19 pandemic. Viet Nam reported over 1,000 cases last year, 21.9 times the 2023 figure. Oceania: Australia reported over 57,000 cases last year, 23.3 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak continued into early this year, with over 3,000 cases reported so far. New Zealand has reported over 1,200 cases cumulatively since mid-October last year, of which 101 were hospitalised and 1 died. Americas: The United States reported over 35,000 cases last year, six times the same period of 2023, and case numbers are rising. Brazil reported over 6,000 cases last year, the highest since 2014.

jtEtwtuo7sORJIGW5lxWlA.zh: 越南南部檳椥省爆發群聚事件,某製衣工廠迄今累計83例,疫情發生於2024/11/6-12/24間,該工廠人員已進行健康檢查,並進行相關防治措施,惟預期病例數將持續增加。
jtEtwtuo7sORJIGW5lxWlA.en: An outbreak cluster has been reported in Bến Tre Province in southern Viet Nam. At one garment factory, 83 cases have been reported cumulatively; the outbreak occurred between 6 November and 24 December 2024. Factory personnel have undergone health checks and relevant control measures have been implemented, but case numbers are expected to continue to rise.

Tvyi6qH8MyrDsJBZfeZJlQ.zh: 越南去年全年累計逾3.8萬例疑病例,其中確診逾6,700例,相較2023年確診數已逾百倍,死亡13例,多數病例來自南部地區,惟北部地區病例數亦呈上升趨勢,有持續擴散趨勢;韓國去年全年累計報告49例,病例皆為境外移入及其接觸病例,感染國家多為中亞及東南亞地區。
Tvyi6qH8MyrDsJBZfeZJlQ.en: Viet Nam reported more than 38,000 suspected cases last year, of which over 6,700 were confirmed, more than 100 times the number confirmed in 2023, with 13 deaths. Most cases came from the southern region, but case numbers in the northern region are also rising, indicating continued spread. South Korea reported 49 cases in total last year; all were imported cases or their contacts, and most infections were acquired in Central Asia and Southeast Asia.

dxO7vWafGaUdxOnyEtOGDg.zh: 南亞越南今年疫情驟升,截至12/21累計報告近5千例病例,已逾去年病例數百倍,分布以胡志明市佔1,800例最多,目前疫情仍持續,近期北部省份疫情亦有上升趨勢,研判此波疫情為自然疾病週期和低疫苗接種率之結果;柬埔寨今年疫情亦上升,截至12/22累計17省報告375例病例,當局呼籲家長確保孩童接種疫苗。 北美加拿大安大略省今年截至12/18累計報告63例病例,較去年之7例大幅上升,其中1例死亡,病患中有37例與新布藍茲維省麻疹群聚事件有關,多數病例未接種疫苗。 東歐烏克蘭今年截至11月累計報告333例病例,為去年同期之6倍,近期西南部車夫契州疫情上升,當局表示已在控制之中,惟仍呼籲兒童及孕婦接種疫苗。 北非摩洛哥北部丹吉爾-得土安-胡塞馬大區近期疫情上升,已知謝夫沙萬省及得土安省已分別報告50及70例病例,並有至少3例兒童死亡案例。
dxO7vWafGaUdxOnyEtOGDg.en: In South-East Asia, Viet Nam's measles outbreak has surged this year: as of 21 December, nearly 5,000 cases had been reported cumulatively, more than a hundredfold increase over last year's total. Ho Chi Minh City accounts for the largest share, with 1,800 cases. The outbreak is still ongoing, and case numbers have recently been rising in northern provinces too. Authorities attribute this wave to the natural disease cycle and low vaccination coverage. In Cambodia, cases have also risen this year: as of 22 December, 375 cases had been reported cumulatively across 17 provinces, and authorities urge parents to make sure their children are vaccinated. In North America, Ontario, Canada, reported 63 cases cumulatively as of 18 December this year, sharply up from 7 cases last year; one patient died. Of these cases, 37 were linked to the measles cluster in New Brunswick Province, and most cases were unvaccinated. In Eastern Europe, Ukraine reported 333 cases cumulatively as of November this year, six times the same period last year. Cases have recently risen in the south-western Chernivtsi Oblast; authorities say the situation is under control but still urge children and pregnant women to be vaccinated. In North Africa, cases have risen recently in the Tangier-Tétouan-Al Hoceima region of northern Morocco. Chefchaouen and Tétouan provinces have reported 50 and 70 cases respectively, and at least three child deaths have occurred.

38KIHrf_aTeVI-3q2saAzQ.zh: 非洲今年截至11/22累計報告23,040例病例,其中11,114例確診,588例死亡(CFR:5.26%),以奈及利亞報告16,747例(461例死亡)最為嚴峻,另有幾內亞報告2,869例、查德2,625例、日746例、茅利塔亞及加彭各數十例亦正處流行期,其中,查德近期疫情明顯上升;非洲區去年報告2.7萬例病例。 越南北部高平省11月新增1例死亡病例,病患為11歲女孩,於11月中旬出現咳嗽及發燒症狀,一週後死亡,當局已進行接觸者隔離及校園消毒。
38KIHrf_aTeVI-3q2saAzQ.en: Africa reported 23,040 cases cumulatively this year as of 22 November, including 11,114 confirmed and 588 deaths (CFR 5.26%). Nigeria has the most severe situation, with 16,747 cases (461 deaths). Guinea reported 2,869 cases, Chad 2,625 and Niger 746, while Mauritania and Gabon each reported several dozen cases; all are in epidemic periods. Chad's recent outbreak has risen markedly. The African Region reported 27,000 cases last year. Viet Nam: In November, Cao Bằng Province in northern Viet Nam reported one new death, an 11-year-old girl who developed cough and fever in mid-November and died a week later. Authorities have quarantined contacts and disinfected the school.

g8cntZ9BxO30i1AvS8KmZQ.zh: 越南今年截至12/13累計33省市報告80例死亡病例,高於近5年平均(70例),其中以中南部平順省、多樂省及義安省最多,該國感染來源以犬貓為主,推測放養犬貓眾多且未接種疫苗可能為主要原因。
g8cntZ9BxO30i1AvS8KmZQ.en: As of 13 December this year, 33 provinces and cities in Viet Nam had reported 80 rabies deaths cumulatively, higher than the five-year average of 70. The highest numbers were in Bình Thuận, Đắk Lắk and Nghệ An provinces in the central and south-central regions. Infection sources were mainly dogs and cats, and authorities presume that the large numbers of free-roaming dogs and cats that have not been vaccinated are the main cause.

M1sukOQUmpaIxIywkOyslg.zh: 越南南部頭頓市爆發食物中毒,累計報告379例,其中1例死亡,多數病患曾於某麵包店購買麵包及糯米飯,自11/27當地陸續出現疑食物中毒病例,出現發燒、腹痛、腹瀉及嘔吐等症狀,當局於店家的豬肉製品及生菜中檢出沙門氏菌及大腸桿菌。
M1sukOQUmpaIxIywkOyslg.en: A food-poisoning outbreak occurred in Vũng Tàu City in southern Viet Nam, with 379 cases reported cumulatively and one death. Most patients had bought bread and sticky rice from a certain bakery. Suspected food-poisoning cases began appearing locally from 27 November, with fever, abdominal pain, diarrhoea and vomiting. Authorities detected Salmonella and Escherichia coli in the shop's pork products and raw vegetables.

6-7cmsiMIu8R_15W1rZp6g.zh: 依WHO監測數據,泰國疫情於7月起驟升,達每月千餘例之規模,明顯高於往年;越南胡志明市9月起疫情爆發,疫情仍在上升,目前達每週300餘例之規模,並有擴散至鄰近同奈及平陽省之趨勢;馬來西亞今年疫情較往年嚴峻,惟下半年已趨緩;菲律賓、印疫情則持續流行,今年處於相對嚴峻之水平。
6-7cmsiMIu8R_15W1rZp6g.en: According to WHO surveillance data, Thailand's outbreak surged from July, reaching more than 1,000 cases a month, clearly higher than in previous years. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, an outbreak began in September and is still rising, currently at over 300 cases a week, and is spreading to neighbouring Đồng Nai and Bình Dương provinces. Malaysia's situation this year has been more severe than in previous years, but has eased in the second half of the year. The Philippines and Indonesia continue to have ongoing epidemics, which are at a relatively severe level this year.

jnF9JaU_cVPnKzWYGT9N6A.zh: 越南疫情更新,胡志明市於近10週病例數持續上升,最近1週報告約700例病例,已有1例死亡,今年迄今累計已逾12,000例惟較去年同期為低。 巴西疫情更新,今年截至11月已累計逾600萬例(疑)病例及5,086例死亡,該國今年病例數已為1986年以來最高,其中以米納斯吉拉斯州最為嚴峻。
jnF9JaU_cVPnKzWYGT9N6A.en:
Viet Nam update: In Ho Chi Minh City, case numbers have kept rising over the past 10 weeks, with about 700 cases reported in the latest week and 1 death so far. Cumulative cases this year exceed 12,000, which is lower than the same period last year.

Brazil update: As of November this year, more than 6 million (suspected) cases and 5,086 deaths have been cumulatively reported. The country's case count this year is already the highest since 1986, with Minas Gerais State the most severely affected.

_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,單週新增病例數突破200例,今年截至11/22累計報告逾1,800例,其中3例死亡,當局已加強疫苗接種措施。 吉爾吉斯今年截至9月累計報告13,358例病例,疫情於6月達高峰後持續下降,目前已趨緩,病例多分布於北部及西南部州別,當局已加強疫苗接種。 非洲疫情持續,今年截至11/8累計報告23萬2,363例病例,其中21,214例確診,3,136例死亡(CFR:1.35%),以剛果民主共和國報告9.2萬餘例最為嚴峻、另有衣索比亞、蒲隆地、摩洛哥、索馬利亞、奈及利亞及布吉納法索報告1至2.8萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,21國報告數十至5千例不等。
_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.

pmSeIKF1tk41eHU9fSNiXA.zh: 香港11/15新增報告1例病例,為觀塘區80歲具慢性病史男性,10/30發病,感染源調查中;當地今年累計報告22例,較前年全年17例為高。 越南11/20新增報告1例病例,為中北部清化省36歲具慢性病史男性,病情嚴重,病患為挖土機工人,可能係於工作環境感染,當局呼籲有傷口者應避免接觸汙染土壤或水源。
pmSeIKF1tk41eHU9fSNiXA.en:
Hong Kong reported 1 new case on 15 November, a man aged 80 with chronic conditions from Kwun Tong District, with onset on 30 October; the source of infection is under investigation. The city has reported 22 cases so far this year, higher than the full-year total of 17 cases in the year before last.

Viet Nam reported 1 new case on 20 November, a 36-year-old man with chronic conditions from Thanh Hoa Province in north-central Viet Nam. The patient is seriously ill and works as an excavator operator and may have been infected in the work environment. Authorities urge people with wounds to avoid contact with contaminated soil or water.

ZLJv8x-qaOcEt2G-exalFA.zh: 美洲疫情更新,加拿大安大略省10月初新增1例死亡案例,病患為兒童並曾接觸蝙蝠,當地蝙蝠帶原比例有升高跡象,當局呼籲民眾與蝙蝠接觸後,無論是否有傷痕,均應就醫治療;巴西托坎廷斯州10月底新增1例病例,暴露情形未敘明,當局已前往調查帶原動物。 亞洲疫情更新,越南同奈省、廣南省分別於9、10月新增1例死亡病例,均係經狗咬傷且未接種疫苗,該國狂犬病發病後死亡率為100%;菲律賓北達沃省10月底新增1例死亡病例,病患曾食用狗肉,當局已啟動追蹤共同暴露者。
ZLJv8x-qaOcEt2G-exalFA.en:
Americas update: In Ontario, Canada, 1 death was newly reported in early October. The patient was a child who had had contact with bats. The proportion of bats carrying rabies in the area appears to be rising. Authorities urge anyone who has had contact with bats to seek medical treatment, regardless of whether there are wounds. In Tocantins State, Brazil, 1 new case was reported in late October; the exposure circumstances were not stated, and authorities have gone to investigate rabies-carrying animals.

Asia update: In Dong Nai and Quang Nam provinces, Viet Nam, 1 death each was newly reported in September and October respectively. Both patients had been bitten by dogs and were unvaccinated. The case fatality rate of rabies in Viet Nam once symptoms develop is 100%. In Davao del Norte Province, Philippines, 1 death was newly reported in late October; the patient had eaten dog meat, and authorities have begun tracing people with shared exposure.

xUM-XKU4QvxeIR_qHyUrjA.zh: 越南南部胡志明市疫情持續上升,10月底單週新增140餘例,今年截至11/7累計報告近1,500例,其中1/4為未符合疫苗接種對象之未滿9個月幼兒,當局已核准6個月以上幼兒提前接種單價麻疹疫苗,並擴大接種對象至學校及社福機構人員。 加拿大東部紐布朗斯維克省(New Brunswick)疫情上升,今年10月中旬迄今累計報告25例,預期仍有潛在案例,當局呼籲民眾加強防護及接種疫苗。
xUM-XKU4QvxeIR_qHyUrjA.en:
Ho Chi Minh City in southern Viet Nam continues to see rising outbreaks. Weekly new cases exceeded 140 in late October, and cumulative cases this year reached nearly 1,500 as of 7 November. About one quarter of cases were infants under 9 months old, who are not eligible for vaccination. Authorities have approved early vaccination with monovalent measles vaccine for children aged 6 months and older, and have expanded vaccination to staff at schools and social welfare institutions.

In New Brunswick, eastern Canada, outbreaks are rising, with 25 cases cumulatively reported since mid-October this year. Further potential cases are expected, and authorities urge people to strengthen protection and get vaccinated.

fzu8i1b55w9en5N7qSG6ig.zh: 越南南部胡志明市疫情持續嚴峻,截至10/13累計報告達1,079例,其中4例死亡,5成病例為5歲以下兒童,該市已透過學校系統加強兒童免疫覆蓋率;該國北部清化省10月初亦爆發疫情,單週新增近40例病例,近7成病例為5歲以下兒童,多數病例未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 西非象牙海岸今年截至10/14累計報告1,287例確診病例,病患多為9歲以下兒童,近9成未接種疫苗或接種史不明;該國前3年病例數約介於1,300至2,000例間。 東非南蘇丹南部瓦拉卜州宣布爆發疫情,截至10/22累計報告88例確診病例,當局已加強疫苗接種。
fzu8i1b55w9en5N7qSG6ig.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City in southern Viet Nam, the outbreak remains severe. As of 13 October, 1,079 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 4 deaths. About half of cases are children under 5 years old, and the city has strengthened children's immunization coverage through the school system. In Thanh Hoa Province in northern Viet Nam, an outbreak also began in early October, with nearly 40 new cases in a single week; nearly 70% of cases are children under 5, and most cases were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history.

Côte d'Ivoire, in West Africa: As of 14 October this year, 1,287 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, mostly children under 9 years old; nearly 90% were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. The country's case numbers in the previous three years ranged from about 1,300 to 2,000.

South Sudan, in East Africa: Warrap State in southern South Sudan has announced an outbreak. As of 22 October, 88 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, and authorities have strengthened vaccination.

7eKPeRsWrB1HC8EQWHT_0g.zh: 據報載,越南多樂省10/19報告1例病例,為10個月大男嬰,9/29出現發燒症狀,2日後發病,當局檢驗疑與VDPV3相關;該國自2000年起即屬無小兒麻痺症國家。
7eKPeRsWrB1HC8EQWHT_0g.en: According to media reports, Dak Lak Province in Viet Nam reported 1 case on 19 October, a 10-month-old boy who developed fever on 29 September and became ill 2 days later. Authorities' testing suggests it may be related to VDPV3. Viet Nam has been free of polio since 2000.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.

Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.zh: 非洲疫情持續,今年截至9/26累計報告21萬8,258例病例,其中19,454例確診,2,968例死亡(CFR:1.25%),以剛果民主共和國8.5萬餘例、衣索比亞2.7萬餘例最多,另有蒲隆地、摩洛哥、奈及利亞、布吉納法索及索馬利亞報告1萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,19國報告數十至5千例不等。 越南南部胡志明市疫情上升,9月底單週新增近百例病例,自疫情爆發(時間不明)截至9/26累計報告達743例,多為5歲以下兒童,當局表示該市之免疫覆蓋率於各地區差異大,目前已超過72%;另報載該國中、北部省份疫情亦在上升。
Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. As of 26 September this year, 218,258 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 19,454 were confirmed and 2,968 died (CFR: 1.25%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 85,000) and Ethiopia (over 27,000) account for the most cases. Burundi, Morocco, Nigeria, Burkina Faso and Somalia each reported over 10,000 cases, Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to 8,000 cases, and 19 countries reported between several dozen and 5,000 cases. In southern Viet Nam, cases in Ho Chi Minh City have risen. Nearly 100 new cases were reported in the last week of September, and since the outbreak began (date unspecified), 743 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 26 September, mostly children under 5. Authorities say immunization coverage differs widely across districts in the city and currently exceeds 72%. Media reports also indicate that cases are rising in central and northern provinces of the country.
